guardrails.interpretation: Chips alone explain Taiwan; controls cause war; dependence guarantees peace
guardrails.reason: History and security have multiple layers; no conflict date or end-use causal evidence is established.

guardrails.interpretation: One omnibus One-China policy; corporate investment proves political stance
guardrails.reason: Keep PRC principle, US policy, Taiwan-specific statements and company activity attributed separately.

guardrails.interpretation: Tariffs, slower growth or bilateral declines prove globalization has ended
guardrails.reason: Do not conflate aggregate levels, growth, geography or value/volume; competing explanations remain.

guardrails.interpretation: Rerouting proves reshoring; all connector trade is transshipment; localization always improves resilience
guardrails.reason: Firm production, value added and ultimate upstream dependence require evidence; country/model results differ.

guardrails.interpretation: Planned or contracted GW equals actual AI energy; energized means fully utilized
guardrails.reason: Separate project identity, stage, power/energy and workload denominator.

guardrails.interpretation: Company PP&E equals AI investment or proves AI returns
guardrails.reason: Use and cash/non-cash scope remain incomplete; an unaudited release is not a full audited filing review.

guardrails.interpretation: Mine equity or nationalization controls national flows and benefits everyone
guardrails.reason: Rights, product forms, exports, finance and distribution are distinct; current compensation/net benefits are unknown.

guardrails.interpretation: Africa acts as one actor; China controls Africa; resources automatically explain coups
guardrails.reason: Separate countries, companies and communities; no hidden exchange or security causal evidence is established.

guardrails.interpretation: An MOU is funded implementation; a commitment is paid cash; permission is shipment
guardrails.reason: Authorization, commitments, disbursement, building and deliveries require different evidence; reuse Batch 1 boundaries.

guardrails.interpretation: BRI is inherently a debt trap, automatically win-win or unconditional aid
guardrails.reason: Intent, contracts, execution and net benefit need evidence; neither political opposite is approved.

guardrails.interpretation: Infrastructure use, traffic or jobs prove financial success and local net benefits
guardrails.reason: Revenue, maintenance, debt service and distribution differ; transferred jobs are not net new jobs.

guardrails.interpretation: A long port lease automatically means debt seizure; disputing that removes all debt risk
guardrails.reason: Construction loans and lease/equity transactions differ. Attributed historical analysis does not establish current terms or motives.

guardrails.interpretation: Taiwan tension means buy gold; AI shortages mean energy rises; coups lift commodities; BRI fixes USD/IBIT direction
guardrails.reason: Intermediate variables, counterforces, expectations and horizons are missing. Market interpretations remain Alpha inference, not permission.
